The PXG One & Done ZT Putter takes a proven PXG mallet profile and re-engineers it with Zero Torque Design, positioning the center of gravity just below the shaft axis to keep the face square from takeaway to impact. It's available in right- and left-handed configurations, and pairs with PXG's Slant Putter Grips — designed with a 1.5° slant to help golfers settle into the natural hand position that zero-torque putters call for.

products.title: GEN8 Irons
products.body_html:
PXG 0311 GEN8 Irons — Explosive Distance, Unmatched Feel

The PXG 0311 GEN8 Irons are the most adjustable irons PXG has ever built. At the heart of GEN8 is the all-new Dual Perimeter Weighting System — independently adjustable heel and toe weights (2g to 12g, in 1g increments) that let PXG Fitters fine-tune ball flight, shape, and start line in real time, all without changing lie angle. The result is a personalized, data-driven fitting experience that boosts MOI for greater forgiveness and control.

GEN8 pairs that adjustability with a suite of speed and feel technologies. An Ultra-Thin Maraging Steel Face — just .050" and PXG's thinnest ever — flexes more at impact for faster ball speeds. Deep Core Recoil Technology creates additional internal space behind the face, amplifying energy transfer for higher launch and more consistent distance, even on off-center strikes. QuantumCOR Internal Polymer fills the clubhead cavity to maximize USGA-legal C.O.R. while dampening vibration for an incredibly soft, responsive feel. Internal tungsten toe weighting centers the CG and stabilizes the head through impact, preserving forgiveness on mishits.

Available in three models to fit every type of player:

  • 0311 XP GEN8 – Maximum forgiveness, distance, and launch with the largest head in the lineup — ideal for mid- to high-handicap golfers.
  • 0311 P GEN8 – A balanced blend of distance, control, and feel in a mid-size head, built for the widest range of players.
  • 0311 T GEN8 – A compact, tour-preferred profile delivering maximum workability and precision for skilled players.

Every set is custom-built to your exact specs — shaft, length, loft, lie, grip, and weighting configuration — through PXG's expert fitting process. Available in Chrome and Xtreme Dark finishes, each head is 5X forged from 8620 carbon steel for premium durability and a pure, consistent sound at impact.

Performance Benefits:

  • Dual Perimeter Weighting System for a completely dialed-in fit
  • QuantumCOR Internal Polymer delivering max USGA-legal C.O.R.
  • Deep Core Recoil Technology for explosive speed off the face
  • High launch with optimized spin control
  • Tight dispersion, even on off-center hits
  • Incredibly soft, responsive feel at impact
